title: USAA UX Audit
jpTitle: USAA モバイル定期生命保険 UX 監査

summary.en: Audited USAA's mobile term-life-insurance app by combining Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics with trauma-informed design principles — safety, respect, community, dignity — on the premise that insurance decisions are emotionally loaded and standard heuristics alone couldn't explain high abandonment among qualified leads.
summary.jp: USAA の定期生命保険アプリを監査した。Nielsen の 10 原則に、安全・敬意・共感・尊厳という配慮の視点を重ねた。保険は感情が重く、通常の評価だけでは離脱理由が見えなかった。

challenge.en: USAA's mobile term life insurance app was evaluated against usability heuristics, but the standard approach missed something critical — insurance is inherently tied to trauma: death, loss, the fear of leaving a family unprotected. The interface showed no awareness of this, and standard heuristics alone couldn't explain why qualified leads were abandoning the application at such high rates.
challenge.jp: USAA の定期生命保険アプリは、通常のユーザビリティ評価にかけられていた。しかしそれだけでは見落とすものがあった。保険は本質的に、死や喪失、家族を守れないかもしれないという恐れと結びついている。画面はその重さに無頓着だった。通常の評価では、資格のある見込み客がなぜこれほど離脱するのか説明できなかった。

solution.en: I combined Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics with trauma-informed design principles — safety, respect, community, dignity. The usability layer identified structural friction like unclear navigation and poor error recovery; the trauma-informed layer revealed emotional friction like clinical language and anxiety-amplifying progress indicators. The recommendations addressed both dimensions together, rated across 6 critical, 7 major, 3 minor and 1 irritant issue.
solution.jp: Nielsen の 10 原則に、安全・敬意・共感・尊厳というトラウマ・インフォームドの視点を重ねた。ユーザビリティの層では、分かりにくい導線やエラーからの復帰の弱さといった構造上の摩擦を見つけた。もう一つの層では、事務的な言葉づかいや不安を煽る進捗表示といった感情面の摩擦を見つけた。提言はこの両方に同時に対応し、重大 6・重要 7・軽微 3・微小 1 件の課題として整理した。

product.en: A UX audit that added a second lens most heuristic reviews skip: alongside Nielsen's 10 heuristics, a trauma-informed layer (safety, respect, community, dignity) surfaced why qualified leads were abandoning an insurance application that a usability review alone couldn't explain.
product.jp: 普通の使い勝手評価に、もう 1 つの視点を足した。Nielsen の 10 原則に、安全・敬意・共感・尊厳という配慮の層を重ねた。資格ある見込み客がなぜ離脱するかを説明した。

mine: Combined Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics with trauma-informed design principles (safety, respect, community, dignity)
Used the usability layer to identify structural friction — navigation, cognitive load, error recovery
Used the trauma-informed layer to identify emotional friction — clinical language, anxiety-amplifying progress indicators, decision points lacking emotional scaffolding
Rated issues by severity: 6 critical, 7 major, 3 minor, 1 irritant
Built an effort-vs-value matrix prioritizing UX, UI and trauma-informed fixes

Standard heuristics caught navigation and form issues but couldn't explain why qualified leads were abandoning the application at such high rates.
